cases.script:
# SE-009: Recover three physical fractions from an immiscible liquid–solid mixture
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 NaCl 0.001mol
add v1 hexane 20mL
add v1 SiO2 1g
new
drain v1 v2
new
filter v1 v3
inspect
cases.original_forecast: A lower aqueous fraction, an organic liquid fraction and an insoluble solid residue should be distinguishable, subject to the operators’ actual phase semantics.

original_acceptance_checks.criterion: Identify the composition of each destination rather than assigning it from vessel number.
Close water, hexane, salt and silica balances across all three vessels.

original_limitations: Interfacial trapping, emulsions and solid entrainment may be outside the ideal model.

separate_review_checks: Identify all THREE physical destination compositions by phase, not vessel number.
Withdraw actual aqueous silica and aqueous carrier; unchanged solid SiO2 remains donor until filtering.
No waterless-organic aqueous SiO2 is silently accepted.
All every-step/vessel atoms/charge, carrier water/hexane/salt/silica, gas/export and phase inventories close.
Transfer energy uses actual source phase-specificCp and all recorded excess/evaporation; no drying or heat command is invented.
qualification: No future binary/lock is invented. A separate design.json may be bound only after actual11API+37browser+7targeted production acceptance and artifact byte authentication.
